https://www.linkedin.com/in/nikhil-wankhade-31023a46 Stackoverflow: https://stackoverflow.com/cv/nikhil_dev
A dynamic and result-oriented techno-functional professional with over 13+ years of progressive experience in software development, with a strong grasp of emerging technologies and a proven track record of delivering scalable, high-performance enterprise applications across diverse domains including Gaming, ITeS, Academia, and Digital Signatures.
Possesses deep expertise in Core Java and Java EE, along with hands-on experience across the entire software development lifecycle (SDLC)—from requirement analysis, design, development, unit testing to integration and deployment of multi-tier, distributed systems.
Demonstrates strong proficiency in Object-Oriented Analysis and Design (OOAD) methodologies, coupled with a sound understanding of Agile and Scrum frameworks. Adept at managing project planning, estimation, scheduling, and resource allocation, while ensuring on-time delivery and maintaining quality standards.
Recognized for the ability to balance technical and business objectives, seamlessly handling multiple roles and responsibilities. Skilled in mentoring, training, and people management, fostering collaborative team environments that drive innovation and performance.
Known as an excellent communicator and proactive problem-solver, with a passion for continuous learning and delivering value through technology. Frequently provides hands-on support to teams, ensuring both individual and collective success.
Technologies & Frameworks Core Java, Java, J2EE [JCE, JPA, JAXB, EJB, JMS, Executers, JDBC, Collections, Multithreading], Apache Artemis, Hibernate, Microservices, Swagger, SQL, Bouncy Castle, Spring Boot [Web, Security, Data, Gateway, Config, Discovery, Remoting], Resilience4J, Shell Script, Spring Framework Front End JavaScript, HTML5, CSS, Angular 16, JQuery, JQueryUI, Jtable, tailwind PKI PKI (Digital Signing), Cryptography, CSR, DSC Issuance, HSM (Safenet & Thales), CRL Generation, AIA, SKI, OpenSSL, Digital Signing & Verification, X509V3 Specification, ECDSA, PKCS7, PKCS7pdf, X.509 CRL (RFC 5280), TSP (RFC 3161), OCSP (RFC 2560), RSA PKCS standards, CMS and CAdES signatures, Hardware Security Modules (HSM), Cryptography, Certificate Life Cycle Management - Issue, Revoke, Renew Database IBM DB2, Postgres, Oracle, MySQL, Mongo, Redis, Kafka Distributed Environment Tomcat, WebSphere, JBOSS EAP, WebLogic, TomEE, OpenEJB, WildFly Development Tools Eclipse, Intellij, Putty, Soap UI, Winscp, Maven, Bitbucket, SVN, Git Repo, PL/SQL Developer, VisiualVM Cloud-CICD Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins, Microk8s Cluster, Traefik, Bitbucket, Git Actions, Workflow, Runner, EFK Stack, GCP, AWS, AZURE Operating Systems Windows family, Unix Family, Mac Family
Designed and implemented a full-scale PKI (Public Key Infrastructure) including Certificate Lifecycle Management (CLM), Certificate Authority (CA), and HSM integration from scratch using Java Cryptography and Bouncy Castle APIs.
Led the end-to-end setup of an on-premises cloud infrastructure, ensuring secure, scalable, and compliant deployment for mission-critical applications.
Architected and managed CI/CD pipelines and DevOps automation frameworks, accelerating release cycles and ensuring high availability across hybrid cloud and containerized environments.
Mentored cross-functional teams and aligned engineering best practices with business objectives, delivering large-scale solutions on Kubernetes and modern DevOps toolchains (e.g., Helm, Jenkins, EFK).
Drove team alignment with business objectives, mentoring engineers, standardizing best practices, and managing large- scale cloud transformations
Supporting the team with architectural changes, code refactoring, vulnerability patching and Java upgrade
Managing a high-performance team through coaching and retraining top talents
Built a scalable infrastructure capable of processing over 1.2 million real-time transactions per day with >90% uptime and enhanced fault tolerance.
Enabled high-throughput data processing through implementation of auto-scaling, distributed caching (e.g., Redis), and asynchronous task handling using message queues (Kafka/ActiveMQ).
Implemented centralized observability frameworks (Fluentd, ELK Stack, Prometheus, Grafana), reducing mean time to resolution (MTTR) by 60%.
Successfully migrated critical systems to in-house cloud infrastructure, leading to a 30% reduction in infrastructure costs and improved governance.
Led Oracle to PostgreSQL migration, transforming 200+ stored procedures, 100+ functions, and complex UDTs with zero downtime
